en: A sentence starts with a capital letter, and so does a name like Max.
Days of the week and the word I always have a capital letter.
Names like Sam and the word I always start with a capital letter.
The frog sat on a log.
the frog sat on a log.
The frog sat on a Log.
Only the first word needs a capital here. Log is not a name.
Names of people and places start with a capital letter.
We went to the beach on Saturday.
We went to the Beach on saturday.
we went to the beach on Saturday.
The sentence starts with a capital, and so does the day Saturday.
Start with a capital and write I as a capital. An apple is not a name.
Which word should start with a capital letter?
Tuesday is a day of the week, so it needs a capital T.
Ben and Ava play in the snow.
ben and Ava play in the snow.
Ben and ava play in the Snow.
Ben and Ava are names, so both need capitals. Snow is not a name.
A name starts with one capital letter at the front.

en.title: Capital letters
en.teach: A sentence starts with a capital letter. Names, days of the week and the word I do too: On Monday I saw Max.
